scientific_integrity: The stated two-pulse four-reservoir theorem is proved analytically from the exact Nash kernel; finite checker supports but does not replace proof. Old Nash source is dated to 1957 only, without an independently verified exact first-public day; the first_public_date here denotes the day-verified 2014 online appearance of the timing-motivating source, not a newly invented date for Nash.
scientific_limitations: Only two equal instantaneous inputs and identical four-stage linear Nash cascades. No nonlinear channel routing, empirical prediction, unequal pulses, or proven universal historical priority. Closely relevant 2014 manuscript full text was inaccessible; compared available material and other primary full text.
title: Sharp two-crest threshold for delayed four-reservoir runoff pulses
